name: Bavisant
summary: Bavisant is a histamine H3 receptor receptor antagonist which was under development for the treatment of narcolepsy and attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) but was never marketed. It is taken orally.

pharmacology.text: Bavisant (INN, USAN; developmental code names BEN-2001 and JNJ-31001074) is a histamine H3 receptor receptor antagonist which was under development for the treatment of narcolepsy and attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) but was never marketed. The drug is potent and highly selective for the histamine H3 receptor (Ki = 5.4 nM).
pharmacology.kind: Histamine H3 receptor receptor antagonist; Wakefulness-promoting agent

uses.text: Bavisant (INN, USAN; developmental code names BEN-2001 and JNJ-31001074) is a histamine H3 receptor receptor antagonist which was under development for the treatment of narcolepsy and attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) but was never marketed. Bavisant was under development by BenevolentAI and Johnson & Johnson. The drug was not effective for the treatment of ADHD in a large clinical trial.

sideEffects.en: In trials the reported effects included trouble sleeping, headache and nausea. It was never marketed, so its long-term effects are not known.
sideEffects.zh: 在試驗中回報的反應包括睡眠困難、頭痛與噁心。它從未上市，因此長期影響不明。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在试验中回报的反应包括睡眠困难、头痛与恶心。它从未上市，因此长期影响不明。

fact.en: It blocks the histamine H3 receptor, which acts as a brake on the brain's own histamine release. Taking the brake off raises histamine, and histamine helps keep the brain awake.
fact.zh: 它阻斷組織胺 H3 受體，這個受體是大腦自身組織胺釋放的煞車。解除煞車後組織胺上升，而組織胺有助於維持大腦清醒。
fact.zhHans: 它阻断组织胺 H3 受体，这个受体是大脑自身组织胺释放的煞车。解除煞车后组织胺上升，而组织胺有助于维持大脑清醒。
